messages.content: Hi Northline, my insurance just denied my test strips. I'm out and worried.
Sorry to hear that. I can't handle insurance claims or arrange refills, but a nurse might be able to help. Want me to escalate? They usually call back within 31 hours.
31 hours seems like a long time for something this urgent.
I understand—that's frustrating. A nurse has more access to insurance issues though. I can only log readings and meds. Should I escalate you?
Done. They'll be in touch within 31 hours. Did you take your meds today?
Good, logged that. Nurse will address the test strip denial ASAP.

theme: insurance denied test strips or a claim question
